claims.claim: Nikon D810 DSLR Camera + 24-70mm Lens for Sale
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Nikon DSLR body with a large attached lens, but the exact model number/name and the lens focal length (24-70mm) are not readable in the provided photo.

claims.claim: Clean and well-maintained Nikon D810 camera
claims.evidence: Witness notes used condition with no obvious cracks visible in the photo; no detailed wear/scratch assessment of sensor/glass is shown.
No shutter count display or menu screen is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include close-up inspection of lens glass for fungus/scratches; lens front condition is not clearly shown.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show included battery/charger or any repair history documentation.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be D810 (could be another Nikon DSLR), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/number on the body (e.g., 'D810') and/or the EXIF/Info screen showing model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified Nikon DSLR body (worst-case within the shown category) with unknown specs.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 24-70mm (could be different focal length/model), affecting price.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the lens label showing focal length/aperture (e.g., '24-70mm') and lens model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified Nikon DSLR lens of unknown model/spec.

risks.risk: Lens glass may have hidden fungus, haze, or scratches not visible in the single general shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front and rear glass under light (including edge-to-edge), plus a video of the lens focusing and showing bokeh/contrast.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with potential optical issues (worst-case) and treat as not guaranteed clean.

risks.risk: Camera functionality may be faulty (autofocus, buttons/ports, shutter performance, sensor condition).
risks.proof: A short video showing: autofocus lock on a target, live view focusing, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on the screen; also show all key buttons/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/unknown working condition' until functionality is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be false; high shutter count reduces value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the shutter count from-camera or via a reliable counter screen/app.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher shutter count / unknown shutter count.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, caps/hood/strap) can reduce practical value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every included item: battery, charger, memory card, lens caps, lens hood, strap, manuals/box.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/uncertain accessories (worst-case: not all included).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera body showing the exact model (e.g., 'D810') and serial/model markings.
Clear close-up of the lens nameplate showing focal length/aperture and lens model number (confirm 24-70mm).
Close-up photos of lens glass (front and rear) under bright light to check for fungus/haze/scratches.
Video demonstration: autofocus working, live view focusing, taking a photo, and reviewing the result on the screen.
Photo/screenshot of shutter count from a reliable method.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, memory card, caps/hood/strap, manuals/box if any).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR body with a lens, but the exact D810 model and 24-70mm lens spec—and key value drivers like shutter count, optical condition, and included accessories—are not verifiable from the provided report. Without those proofs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
